messages:
jamie: heads up — sudden spike routing to /api/v1/generate is saturating premium GPU pool. can we do a fast ingress guardrail switch to route-match X-Route-Guard -> fallback-low while we investigate? :warning:
kevin: oncall here. can we just drop qps with a rate-limit? less blast radius but slower to impact the queue
jamie: rate-limit won't free up warm KV caches; we need to keep throughput for tiered customers. plan is to route non-HighTier requests to smaller instances (fallback-low) based on header absence. low-risk scope: only requests without `X-HighTier: true`.
alex_chen: ok give me the exact toggle steps. we should do both console and API so we can roll back fast.
jamie: steps I tested in staging:
```
# toggle via internal policy API
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://internal-policies.redwood/api/policies/ingress-guardrail-v1/toggle \
  -d '{"mode":"fallback-low","match":{"header":"X-HighTier","exists":false}}'
```
Then confirm with: `GET /api/policies/ingress-guardrail-v1` and watch `router.queue_length` in console.
deploy-bot: policy-service: ingress-guardrail-v1 toggled -> fallback-low by jamie (run_id: 9d3f) :white_check_mark:
jamie: rolled the toggle. initial metrics: gpu-queue-depth down ~42%, 95p latency for premium unchanged. keeping for 10m and watching.
maya: updated observability — added temporary panel: `ingress.guardrail.mismatch_rate` + `gpu.queue_depth` with 1m granularity. set alert threshold at 20% mismatch increase.
priya: rollback playbook if this causes regressions:
```
# rollback
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  https://internal-policies.redwood/api/policies/ingress-guardrail-v1/toggle \
  -d '{"mode":"passthrough"}'
```
Also revert route table in console -> Routes -> ingress -> ingress-guardrail-v1 -> "Mode" -> Passthrough.
kevin: FYI we should ping GTM: some customers may not be sending X-HighTier header correctly. @sales-ops FYI :eyes:
jamie: good call — I DM'd account-eng for the top 10 active enterprise orgs. this change preserves latency for those that set the header; others will get fallback-low behavior until they fix headers.
ops-bot: incident-log: created INC-7894 "ingress guardrail emergency switch" by jamie. timeline attached.
jamie: leaving note — if we need to expand scope later, we'll add a short-lived cookie-based opt-out rather than global revert. for now monitor for any 5xx spikes in fallback-low pool.
kevin: thanks — I'll keep watching oncall channel and can flip rollback if we see client errors.
alex_chen: saved CLI commands to runbook and pinned the dashboard link in the thread.
jamie: closing loop: maintain for 10m, then either promote to staged rollout or revert. thanks all :rocket:
